::: {#exm-ss-within}
#### Within-group sum of squares of two small groups

For the groups of @exm-ss-between:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{SS}_\text{within}
&= \sb{(1-2)^2 + (2-2)^2 + (3-2)^2} + \sb{(4-5)^2 + (5-5)^2 + (6-5)^2}
&& \text{(definition)}\\
&= 2 + 2
&& \text{(arithmetic)}\\
&= 4
&& \text{(arithmetic)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
